findings.title: Presenter DTO union is undefined
findings.problem: LiveRenderableMessage is named but its exact fields, nullability, sender placement, card shape, and transport-to-renderer mapping are not specified.
findings.fix: Define an exact discriminated JSON/TypeScript union for every supported message and action variant, with representative fixtures and explicit stripping/rejection rules.

findings.title: Authoritative server compiler has no implementation boundary
findings.location: Technology and repository fit; Server lifecycle and validation
findings.problem: The design requires server-side Live RCS compilation but only identifies the client TypeScript preflight; no server module, signature, or parity strategy is defined.
findings.fix: Add a server compileLiveRcsFlow(flow, options) contract/module, call it before session creation, and test server/client parity with shared fixtures.

findings.title: API migration and compatibility are underspecified
findings.location: Server contract and data ownership; HTTP errors and recoverability
findings.problem: Replacing sessionView while preserving only id/status does not preserve current consumers that read events/outbound, and the error envelope changes from strings to objects without endpoint-by-endpoint migration rules.
findings.fix: Specify exact response schemas for every live endpoint and choose either an atomic client migration to a versioned v1 DTO or a documented legacy plus new snapshot contract; add contract tests.

findings.title: Timeline persistence and concurrent mutation rules are missing
findings.location: Server contract and data ownership; Server lifecycle and validation
findings.problem: No persisted schema/migration for old sessions, append/ordinal allocation algorithm, per-session serialization, or send/save crash recovery is defined.
findings.fix: Define session schemaVersion/timeline/nextOrdinal migration, serialize session mutations, allocate IDs before sends, and specify recovery for provider-send/save failures.

findings.title: URL-less open_url mapping cannot satisfy the existing Action type
findings.location: Client projection boundary; Phone and sidebar rendering
findings.problem: The design strips open_url URLs but maps the action to the existing Action model, whose open_url variant requires url.
findings.fix: Introduce a separate display-only live action type or an explicit renderer prop/type that has kind and label but no URL, and test exhaustive action mapping.

findings.title: Read-only renderer path is not specified completely
findings.problem: Current ConversationView creates local callbacks from history and current renderers perform toast, modal, download, and simulator-handler side effects; 'thread readOnly' does not define the required signatures or callback suppression path.
findings.fix: Define readOnly-aware MessageRenderer and ConversationView APIs, use a live-only entry branch with no local callbacks, and make every callback-bearing renderer passive with component tests.

findings.title: Active mode with no valid projection can leak local history
findings.location: Phone and sidebar rendering; Client projection boundary
findings.problem: The conditional liveSessionActive && liveProjection leaves behavior unspecified when the projection is null during startup or invalid-payload recovery, allowing a fallback to local history contrary to live isolation.
findings.fix: When active, always render the live branch; use an empty/unavailable live view until a valid projection exists and retain the last valid view on fetch errors.

findings.title: Inbound recognition and ordering semantics are ambiguous
findings.location: Server contract and data ownership; Server lifecycle and validation
findings.problem: The design does not define payload extraction precedence, event-id requirements, duplicate behavior, user-item node IDs, text sanitization, or deterministic user-before-outbound ordering.
findings.fix: Specify a normalized inbound result and append the recognized user item with an ordinal before routing/outbound append; explicitly choose and test no-target behavior.

findings.title: Provider status enum mapping is unspecified
findings.location: Server contract and data ownership; HTTP errors and recoverability
findings.problem: The snapshot has a closed provider-status enum while current handling stores arbitrary provider strings, with no unknown/casing/order/timestamp rules.
findings.fix: Define a provider-status mapping table, unknown-status behavior, receipt timestamp, and repeated/out-of-order callback tests.

findings.title: Redaction and media-URL policy is incomplete
findings.location: Server contract and data ownership; HTTP errors and recoverability
findings.problem: The design describes bounded pattern masking but no recursive policy for nested content/activity or policy for credentials and signed query parameters in media URLs; bounded provider error text is not necessarily safe.
findings.fix: Define one recursive sanitizer and public-URL policy, replace provider details with safe codes before diagnostics, and assert secrets/raw IDs/payload fragments are absent from all serialized outputs.

findings.title: Public-variable schema extension lacks default and migration rules
findings.problem: The proposed metadata.livePublicVariables field is absent from the current schema and has no import/export, persistence, validation-stage, or absent-field behavior.
findings.fix: Add it as optional with default [], preserve it through scenario formats, enforce limits at server validation, and never fall back to publishing all variables.
